description: Configure an additional calculation mode. MassFlow's live option list is cluster, creep, dynamic, fluid-explicit, fluid-flow, fluid-implicit, imass, mechanical, thermal. Must be given before 'model solve' / 'model cycle' invokes that mode.
notes: The option list is engine-specific. MassFlow's nine options were enumerated from the live 9.8.54 engine; there is no array, cfd, energy, feblock, highorder, hotetra, matrixflow or axisymmetry here (unlike FLAC3D/PFC/MPoint).
The three fluid modes are mutually exclusive per model: after one is configured the other two are rejected with 'fluid has already been configured in a different mode'. 'model new' resets the choice.
'fluid-flow' resolves to the implicit scheme ('Process fluid configured in mode fluid-flow fluid-implicit.').
Once configured, a mode stays active for the model.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: itasca.command('model configure dynamic') - no direct SDK method

verification: Live-verified 2026-11-10 on MassFlow 9.8.54 (GUI bridge) (state grade): all nine options executed individually on fresh models; each printed its confirmation line (fluid-flow and fluid-implicit on separate fresh models; fluid-flow/-implicit/-explicit exclusivity confirmed by the rejection message).
